item.tib: bder gshegs rig 'dzin dgongs pa 'dus pa 'chi med gsang ba sum dril gyi rgyud las gsang zlog byad ma gting len
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan gar dbang rad+na gling pa'am 'chi med 'jam dpal rdo rje rtsal lam/ ye shes g.yung drung bstan pa'i nyi mas gter bdag gi lung bzhin ang+ka ra zhes chu pho sprel lo'i rta pa zla ba'i yar tshes rgyal ba gshen rab mi bo sku 'khrungs ba'i dus chen skabs su gnas chen shel ri phyug mo'i ngo mtshar zla gam phug gi chu srin gre ba nas rgyas bkrol te/ slar lung rig smra ba'i bdag nyid spa ston 'jigs med smra ba'i seng ge dbyangs can dgyes pa'i zla ba legs bshad bdud rtsi'i 'od snang mchog dang / spa btsun tshul khrims dbang rgyal sogs las can bla grwa mang pos bskul ba dang / nye ba sprul pa'i gter chen bde chen gling pa'i rgyud 'dzin rgyal sras pad ma phrin las sras yum lhan rgyas nas rab dkar lha reg gis mtshams sbyar nas bskul bzhin/ chu bya sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes brgyad pa gsang 'dus sngags kyi dus chen gyi skabs su shog ser la zhal bshus shing drung yig tshul khrims blo ldan nas bgyis shing / yi ge dang po'i byed po 'gru bon drung mu a yu sha sa pas mtho phyogs spyi bor blangs te bris pas gsang chen bstan pa rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
